newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street seen rising at open, eyes on Dow 8,000.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street seen rising at open, eyes on Dow 8,000.

text.p: U.S. stocks were expected to rise at the market open Wednesday, with the Dow industrials crossing the 8,000 mark for the first time, analysts said.
Share prices would be pushed higher by upbeat prospects for second quarter earnings, the psychological will to hit 8,000 and strong quarterly results from technology company Motorola Inc, they said.
"Stocks are being stimulated by promising expectations for an earnings stream that may meet or beat estimates," Alan Ackerman, market strategist at Fahnestock & Co, said.
The Standard & Poor's 500 futures index was up 1.95 points at 929.75 while the long bond rose 9/32 to yield 6.56 percent.
Motorola, which posted stronger-than-forecast quarterly results, would lead the technology sector up, helping it digest below-forecast results from Advanced Micro Devices Inc, analysts said.
Motorola reported second quarter earnings of $0.62 per share compared with a First Call estimate of $0.56 per share.
Chipmaker Advanced Micro posted second quarter earnings of $0.07 a share versus a First Call estimate of $0.22 per share.
Some analysts said cyclical stocks could also rise.
